title: mbe-world-heavyweight-championship
label: Doc Silver

won.source: MBE's own Title History document (its 19th recorded reign): defeated Justin Evitable in a decision match at an earlier pay-per-view billed MBE Total Elimination, not itself served

note: Retained the title against Promo on the first fwrestling.com-era show read this pass (20 July 2007); no further title match survives in the held record.

title: mbe-world-tag-team-championship
label: The Thrillbillies

won.source: MBE's own Title History document (its 29th recorded reign) states the Thrillbillies won these titles from a prior champion team at an event billed MBE Awakenings, not itself served; the document's own printed day-and-month for this entry conflict with MBE's own FAQ, posted 29 June 2007, which already lists the Thrillbillies as champions, so only the year is used here

note: Retained the titles in a ladder match against the Sheffield Wednesday Lot on the first fwrestling.com-era show read this pass (20 July 2007); no further title match survives in the held record.
